About Laurence

Welcome to the official website of Laurence Colborne — songwriter, vocalist, and teller of hard-won truths.

The World of Music According To Laurence Colborne is a dark country-noir confession: songs about the bottle, the fall, the woman who never left your mind, and the revenge you never took. Think outlaw honesty, late-night rooms, and melodies that bleed.

Recorded independently between the South Coast and London, Laurence’s current run moves from the stark sobriety anthem “When I Finally Put The Bottle Down” through “If Loving You Is A Crime I’m Guilty As Sin” and “You’re A She-Devil With A Silver Tongue” — all three out now — to the next single Revenge, out August 28.

For press, licensing & bookings — DM via Instagram or email via Ditto profile.
